Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below (some already mentioned by @LDdevv):

Goal
* Please format all instances of "n" and "k" as [[variables]].

* Please format all instances of "8" as {{constants}}.

Input
* Please format "Line 1" and "Line 2" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "n" and "k" as [[variables]].

Constraints
* Please format "n" and "k" as [[variables]].

Cases
* Please remove the trailing newlines from the input for:
  • Basic Encryption (Test 1)
  • Complementary Bits (Test 5)

* Each test and its corresponding validator should cover the *same scenario*, but use *different inputs* when possible. Currently, all the cases have different names, which makes it seem like each test/validator pair is covering a different scenario. If that's the case, please expand each case into a pair of cases to cover the same scenario as described.

* Please add a pair of new cases where n = 0 and k ≠ 0.

Thanks.
